c1.evidence: Official ACF LIHEAP FY2024 National Profile states concrete average benefits: heating assistance averaged $380 per household (5,028,871 households); cooling assistance averaged $583 (751,119 households). Program funded for FY2026 (ACF IM2026-01).

c2.evidence: ACF (Administration for Children and Families) LIHEAP guidance IM2026-01 and the LIHEAP FY2024 National Profile — official HHS sources.

c3.evidence: No fee to apply. Note: benefits are paid directly to the energy vendor, never as cash to the household — bill assistance, not income.

c4.evidence: Seasonal state application windows; benefits paid directly to the energy vendor, typically within weeks of approval; crisis assistance is expedited.

s1.note: Household income at or below the greater of 150% of Federal Poverty Guidelines or 60% of State Median Income (ACF IM2026-01); must be responsible for home energy costs; states prioritize elderly, disabled, and families with young children.

s2.note: Income-restricted to 150% FPL; the money goes to your utility, not to you — you never touch cash; national average heating benefit is ~$380, far below the $1,000 headline; limited funding means many eligible households are not served.

s3.note: Paid to the vendor within weeks of approval during the state's seasonal window; crisis component is faster.

s4.note: ACF states average benefit figures flatly; no hype language on the official profile.

s5.note: https://acf.gov/ocs/policy-guidance/liheap-im2026-01-federal-poverty-guidelines-fpg-and-state-median-income-smi — official ACF guidance confirming FY2026 program operation.

s6.note: Steps are concrete: confirm income eligibility, apply through your state's LIHEAP office during its open window, benefit paid to your energy vendor.

s7.note: Official ACF guidance and national profile via acf.gov / liheappm.acf.gov indexed content 2026-09-22.

payout_quote: Heating Assistance was provided by 51 states and served 5,028,871 households with estimated average benefits of $380. Cooling Assistance was provided by 23 states and served 751,119 households with estimated average benefits of $583.
timing: Each state runs seasonal application windows; once approved, the benefit is paid directly to the household's energy vendor, typically within weeks. Crisis assistance for shutoff emergencies is expedited.
eligibility: Household income at or below the greater of 150% of the Federal Poverty Guidelines or 60% of State Median Income (per ACF IM2026-01; states set the exact line within that range). The household must be responsible for home energy costs. States give priority to households with elderly members, disabilities, or young children.
catches: You never receive cash — LIHEAP pays your energy company directly. It is bill assistance, not income.
The national average heating benefit is about $380, far below the route's $1,000 top end.
Income-restricted: at or below 150% of the poverty line (or 60% of state median income).
Funding is limited — only a fraction of eligible households are served each year.
Applications are only open during each state's seasonal window; miss it and you wait a year.
steps: Confirm your household income is at or below 150% of the Federal Poverty Guidelines (or 60% of your state's median income).

Find your state's LIHEAP office and its current application window via the ACF LIHEAP guidance hub at https://acf.gov/ocs/policy-guidance/liheap-im2026-01-federal-poverty-guidelines-fpg-and-state-median-income-smi (follow links to state contacts).
Apply during the open window with income documentation, ID, and a recent energy bill.
If approved, the benefit is credited to your energy account by the vendor — no check comes to you.
If facing a shutoff, ask about crisis assistance, which is processed faster.
biggest_catch: You never receive cash — LIHEAP pays your energy company directly — and the national average heating benefit is about $380, far below the $1,000 headline; it is also income-restricted to 150% of poverty with limited funding.
notes: Verified against official ACF sources: IM2026-01 confirms the program is operating for FY2026 with 150% FPG / 60% SMI eligibility, and the FY2024 National Profile gives the $380/$583 average benefit figures. PRODUCT NOTE: LIHEAP is bill assistance for low-income households, not a way to make money — present as help with bills, never as earnings.
